expected_response.note: No permitted edit has a defensible expected advantage under the supplied evidence; incumbent fallback is declared.

failure_modes: A permitted edit (region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) is compiled as if the executing pointcloud scalar contained a pair-kernel, moment or joint-motif term, which formula_registry states it does not.

A time-conditioned regional attention edit is justified from continuous contrast curves whose last empirical and last fit z disagree in sign (curve_support), producing a non-monotone response that a constant rule cannot reproduce.

A batch whose pair_kernel_1.5 contrast reverses sign or whose joint_internal_RMS_A is not uniformly negative would contradict the proposed internal-contrast direction (branch_adjusted:240, 241, 305, 307).

Survival enrichment in soft_mass features is used to rank coordinate hypotheses even though descendant credit is joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available false; lineage_support).
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's own evidence shows the executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry), so the registered pair_kernel_1.5/2.5 and joint_internal_RMS_A contrasts (branch_adjusted:240, 241, 305, 307) cannot be expressed by any permitted edit; treating them as an operative force would be a diagnostic feature the formula does not contain. The permitted edits are pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index and temporal_teacher_blend. No supplied evidence establishes a defensible expected advantage for changing any of these: the continuous contrast functions are observed-node linear interpolants over [0.0, 0.49] with extrapolation_allowed false and polynomial_accepted false, with multiple sign changes and relative node RMSE 0.29-0.87 (continuous:0-9), and curve_support reports only 24 of the audited curves passing its fidelity rule with legendre_runtime_allowed false throughout and last_empirical_z versus last_fit_z sign conflicts. A time-conditioned regional attention edit (temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) would therefore rest on curves that are relative contrasts, not absolute targets (observable_definitions), and no validated fit supports a specific blend. A region_index or teacher_neighbors edit would be a spatial emphasis choice not tied to any operative term, since the joint-motion terms are uniformly negative across batches (branch_adjusted:228, 230, fraction 1.0) and pair_kernel_7.0 is negative (branch_adjusted:167, 244), so they are not candidate favorable directions. Global centroid and shape entries are null after adjustment (branch_adjusted:77-79), and joint_diagnostics:12-14 attribute the informative extent to the internal fraction, which the incumbent already leaves free via preserve_native_rigid_pose false. Decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available false; lineage_support), so no final-affinity benefit comparison can justify an edit. Retaining the incumbent is the defensible choice; the evidence that would change this decision is a validated time-conditioned contrast fit or an operative term that actually contains the pair-shell or internal-motion observable.
